banks.name: Original
banks.purpose: Historical 64-word menu. This graph explores four short-clue rules. The measured pilot used the whole word, first half and last half.
banks.notes: Even positions are available here as a design diagnostic. The historical Kev walkthrough delivered odd positions in its alternating arm.

banks.name: Default
banks.purpose: A 64-word menu curated for half-word collisions.
banks.notes: The two variants share 52 word slots. In the default, all 64 words appear in the top 50,000 English subtitle words. Rare included changes 12 slots to lower-frequency words. Every collision across all four eight-letter masks is matched slot for slot between the two variants. The two rule families have different menus.

banks.name: Balanced deletions
banks.purpose: Sixteen words selected for rule disclosure. SURE can arrive from UNSURE, SUTURE or SURETY through three different deletions.
banks.notes: The earlier 16-word preview gave 0.099 bits per rule. This bank gives 0.896 bits under each rule. Fourteen strings cross rules and 34 of 48 assignments benefit. Ideal recovery rises from 28/48 to 47/48. The finite search used 8,255 six-letter forms. An independently checked bound of 1.005 bits leaves a gap to the global optimum on this pool. LIVEST, LIEDER and VESTAL illustrate the vocabulary cost of purely information-based selection.

analysis: Uniform targets and independent equiprobable listed rules; all graph data are deterministic design enumeration.
